notes.title: Small Changes Based on Your Feedback!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We're delighted to share some recent improvements made in response to your valuable feedback. While there's still work to be done, we're committed to enhancing your gaming experience to the best of our abilities.

Enhanced Bridge Visuals:
We've taken the time to revamp the visuals of our bridges, making them more aesthetically pleasing. Additionally, we're working on a feature that lets you place tiles on the bridges, as suggested by many of you.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43376969/fc24ea6288aed98c915810cd4230e934a07fe55e.png

Information at Your Fingertips:
We've introduced a handy feature in response to your feedback. Now, when you hover your mouse over a UI element, a small information bubble will pop up, giving you details about that element. It's a small change that should make navigating the game easier.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43376969/a68eb3dd97c69f7a33f75bad0216126fcc6ae9a9.png

Balancing Metrics:
Game balance is essential, and we've reviewed the game's metrics to ensure a balanced and engaging experience. You'll notice some subtle adjustments that aim to improve gameplay while keeping it exciting and challenging.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43376969/482b134aa7eb1781b4ab8bf8f9ed6f7f266a8045.png

Enhanced Tutorial:
Your feedback on our tutorial has been invaluable, and we've made some tweaks to make it more informative and intuitive, especially for new players.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43376969/3295c4b86207fb38bae123859f17616daf286ee9.png



We hope these updates will enhance your enjoyment and meet the quality standards you expect from us. Your feedback is important to us, so please continue to share your thoughts on these changes and provide ideas for the future.

Thank you for being part of our wonderful community. We look forward to your reactions and are excited to keep making our game an even more special place for everyone. Stay tuned for more updates!

See you in the game,
The Tiny Atolls Team
